stories.title: Scientists discover a hidden danger of viral infections that vaccines may prevent
summary: A new study reveals that viral infections may leave behind hidden damage to the immune system long after symptoms disappear.
Researchers found that mice recovering from an acute infection experienced lasting changes to their spleens and weakened immune responses, potentially leaving them more vulnerable to future threats.
Surprisingly, prior vaccination completely prevented these harmful changes in the mouse model.

stories.title: Superheated magma could fuel towering lava fountains
summary: Why do some volcanoes erupt with spectacular lava fountains while others release lava more quietly?
Scientists have discovered that a hidden effect of extreme heat inside magma may help explain the difference.
Experiments revealed that superheated magma can delay crystal formation for more than eight hours, compared with just 20 minutes in magma that has not been superheated.

stories.title: Dark energy may have flipped from negative to positive 9.5 billion years ago
summary: A mysterious force driving the expansion of the Universe may have undergone a dramatic reversal billions of years ago.

Scientists exploring an overlooked branch of an alternative gravity theory discovered that dark energy could have switched from negative to positive roughly 9.5 billion years ago, potentially changing how we understand cosmic history.

stories.title: The Sun unleashed a monster storm. Earth may have made it worse
summary: The massive solar storm that illuminated skies worldwide in May 2024 has uncovered an unexpected twist: Earth's own atmosphere may have helped make the storm so powerful.
Satellite measurements revealed that roughly 85% of the charged particles fueling the disturbance originated from Earth's upper atmosphere rather than the solar wind.
Scientists also detected an extraordinary 40% weakening of Earth's magnetic field high above the planet.
